title: Raku Ceramic Workshop
source_quote:
Raku Ceramic Workshop
Saturday, October 3, 2026
10:00 AM
3:00 PM
evidence_sentence: Robin Foster leads a live Raku firing demonstration where participants glaze pre-made pieces and watch them pulled glowing from the fire on the RiverPlace patio.
evidence_quote: A rare opportunity to join former exhibiting artist Robin Foster for an immersive workshop and live Raku firing demonstration. Guests glaze a pre-made ceramic piece by the award-winning artist, then watch as it is pulled glowing and transformed from the fire on the RiverPlace patio.
summary: Join a one-day raku workshop on October 3, 2026 where you glaze a pre-made ceramic piece and watch it fired in a live demonstration. Lunch is provided.
